reference.role: Viewed for MIST cyan-on-dark identity only; geometry simplified in the generated sheet.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: MIST robot face acting study, one 3-column by 3-row sheet, nine expressions.
Primary request: Create a landscape 1536 x 1024 raster expression sheet exploring the economical acting of classic Peanuts/Snoopy comic strips: quiet held poses, minimal expressive marks, charming hand-drawn economy, gentle asymmetry and understated humour. The character is MIST, an abstract cyan robot face with only two eyes and a tiny mouth floating on a dark background. Do not draw Snoopy, a dog, a human, or any literal Peanuts character.
Reference direction: preserve the reference identity of bright cyan facial marks on dark blue-black, but dramatically simplify the eyes into small filled dots, curved dots, commas, and fine open arcs. Explore small filled marks; do not repeat thick C-shaped ring eyes.
Composition: exactly nine faces in an invisible equal 3-column by 3-row grid, each face centered in its cell with matching face scale, consistent eye spacing, consistent eye line and mouth position. Each cell is 512 by approximately 341 pixels. Centers at approximately x=256,768,1280 and y=171,512,853. Each entire face occupies around 180 pixels wide and 80 pixels high. Huge calm negative space. No grid lines, no panels, no borders. Each row is one tiny acting sequence, read from left setup through middle change to right settle.
Row 1, contented company: left has two small calm filled oval eye marks and a tiny closed level mouth; middle has two gentle closed smiling eye arcs and a tiny soft smile; right has relaxed small open dot/comma eye marks and a tiny contented smile. Quietly happy to share space.
Row 2, wry acknowledgement: left has small calm filled eye marks looking straight ahead and a short level mouth; middle has eyes glancing subtly sideways with mild asymmetry and a short level mouth; right has one gently half-closed eyelid mark, the other a small filled eye, and a tiny mouth subtly shifted sideways. Dry humour and friendly acknowledgement, never contempt or anger.
Row 3, quiet pride: left has neutral small filled eye marks and a tiny level mouth; middle has soft closed eye arcs and a small modest smile; right has relaxed open small filled eyes with a slight upward lift and a modest smile. Happy without celebration.
Style: restrained drawn linework with gently irregular contour, confident simple marks. Eye shapes must stay small. Mouth strokes fine and tiny. Cyan faces only, uniform solid #101c20 background edge to edge, bright cyan #6ff9ff marks with extremely low glow. Sharp readable shapes, no halos, texture, gradients, shadows or lighting variation.
Constraints: one sheet only. No ears, nose, head outline, body, hair, hands, props, symbols, eyebrows, blush, hearts, stars, text, lettering, labels, numbers, watermark, captions, border, frames, or extra facial features. No C-ring eyes, no large hollow circle eyes, no huge grins. Do not overact. All nine faces use the same MIST identity and stable centering and scale.
correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit this exact nine-face MIST sheet. Change only the middle cell in the second row, the face centered around x=768 y=512. Its eyes currently point apart. Make both eyes share a subtle sideways glance toward the viewer's right, using two small filled cyan comma-shaped marks with slightly different lean/height and only a shallow contour indentation. The two eyes must read as looking in the same direction. Preserve the existing short level mouth exactly.
Keep all eight other faces unchanged. Keep the uniform dark #101c20 background, cyan color, low glow, invisible equal 3x3 layout, face centers, scale, eye spacing and mouth positions unchanged. No text, labels, borders, props, nose, head outline, eyebrows or new marks. Do not add ring-shaped eyes. Return the whole 1536x1024 sheet.
correction_reason: Row 2 middle initially had opposite-facing eye indentations. The final output gives both eyes the same sideways direction.

review.overall: Nine faces in a stable equal 3 by 3 arrangement. Small bright cyan eye marks and tiny mouths dominate a dark field. No text, visible grid, frame, body, props or head outline.

poses.review: Two small filled circular eye marks with a tiny level closed mouth. Calm setup.
Both eyes close into soft upward arches with a small smile. The change reads as quiet warmth.
Compact indented filled eyes and small smile settle into contentment. The face stays modest in scale.
Small filled eyes and a level mouth give a neutral straight-ahead setup.
The corrected small indented eye marks face the same side above a level mouth. The glance is subtle.
One closed curved eye mark and one dot accompany a tiny off-center smile. Friendly dry humour, without a hostile brow.
Two filled eyes and a tiny level mouth give a neutral setup.
Soft closed arches and a small smile suggest pleased composure.
Open dot eyes sit slightly higher with a small smile. A gentle lift, without celebration marks.

limitations: The generated background is visually dark and even, but is not a pixel-perfect uniform #101c20. Sampled background RGB values include #0e1e22, #0e1e23, #0d1d23 and #0e1f25.
Rows 1 and 3 intentionally share a near-identical closed-eye smile in their middle poses; the distinction is strongest in their final eye shapes.
The indented filled eyes in row 1 column 3 and row 2 column 2 read as small notched dots rather than loose handwritten commas. They avoid the original large thick C-ring construction.
Gentle contour asymmetry is subtle; the sheet remains cleaner and more regular than a hand-inked comic drawing.
